data TULs could not be established for vitamin K thiamin riboflavin vitamin B12 pantothenic acid biotin or carotenoids. In the absence of TULs extra caution may be warranted. in consuming levels above recommended 
intakes.

dThe TULs for vitamin E niacin and folate apply to synthetic forms obtained from supplements fortified foods or a combination of the two.
